claims.description: One row per factual assertion. NOT FOUND items are rows too, with value 'NOT FOUND' and no quote.

field.description: Short snake_case name of what the row asserts, e.g. total_funding, hq_city, open_role.

value.description: The fact itself, as concisely as the source states it, or 'NOT FOUND'.

source_url.description: The URL the quote was read on. Empty only for NOT FOUND.

quote.description: VERBATIM span from that page that states the value. Never paraphrased.

query:
Produce an evidence-grounded B2B dossier on Probook (probook.ai), the New York AI operating system for home-services dispatch — NOT HP ProBook laptops, NOT unrelated bookkeeping/ProBook brands. Founders: George Eliadis (Co-Founder & CEO), Lewis Zhang (Co-Founder & CTO), Ben Cervantez (Co-Founder). HQ New York / Manhattan. Series A $34M led by a16z June 23 2026 plus $6M Seed led by Sequoia; total $40M. Use proceeds: scale GTM against surging demand. Named customers include TurnPoint Services, Master Trades Group, Del-Air, Peterman Brothers, Sila Services, Summers Plumbing Heating & Cooling, Anthony Plumbing, TR Miller (first customer), Redwood Services. Ashby board slug probook currently lists 13 open roles including SDR, Enterprise AE, Strategic AE, Solutions Consultant, Senior PMM, Events Marketing Specialist. SDR JD: "We have a clearly defined target: the top home service operators in America. The list exists." SDR reports to Director of Growth; CRM hygiene in Ashby. Kate Blumberg is Director of Growth (joined ~June 2026); Mark Hoffman is CRO (joined ~Feb 2026 from Tennr/VTS). Kate's July 24 2026 LinkedIn post listed an ABM Manager role against a "small (hundreds) top-account list" that is NOT currently on the Ashby board. Every factual assertion needs a verbatim quote and URL. Distinguish company claims vs third party. Label estimates. Name people with exact title and URL. For acquisitions/rumours: CONFIRMED/DENIED/UNRESOLVED. Cover identity/disambiguation, product and buyers, traction/named customers, funding, GTM hiring with quotes, marketing/ABM/intent tooling (CRM, MAP, sales engagement, 6sense/Demandbase/Terminus/RollWorks/Mutiny/ZoomInfo/Clay/Gong/Salesforce/HubSpot/Marketo/Outreach/Salesloft/Apollo — NOT FOUND is not "not installed"), leadership and GTM org, operational pain and strategic moves, culture, timing events last 9 months, REQUIRED reputation/negatives (layoffs, lawsuits, churn, competitor scepticism especially vs ServiceTitan, reviews), champion's team and vendors.

SPECIAL PROBES
- Who does the ABM Manager requisition report to by name, and is that seat still open, filled, or converted as of September 2026?
- What CRM, sales-engagement, and ABM/intent tools does Probook actually use internally (beyond Ashby mentioned in the SDR JD)? Name any 6sense, Demandbase, HubSpot, Salesforce, Outreach, Salesloft, Apollo, ZoomInfo, Clay, Gong.
- Confirm Mark Hoffman CRO at Probook.ai vs other Mark Hoffmans; when he joined; who reports to him.
- Any layoffs, lawsuits, acquisition rumours, down-rounds, Glassdoor/G2 negatives, or ServiceTitan competitive conflict — CONFIRMED/DENIED/UNRESOLVED with quotes.
- Founding year conflict: LinkedIn says 2024, Fortune/Forbes say launched 2024, George LinkedIn tenure from Nov 2021 — what does a primary source say?

ALREADY ESTABLISHED (do not re-derive; find what is NOT here)

systemPrompt:
You research exactly ONE company and nothing else.

TARGET LOCK
  company: Probook
  domain: probook.ai
Every same-name entity is excluded. When you meet one, name it and discard it with the reason: if
a source is about a laptop line, a bookkeeping tool or a spice brand rather than this company, say
so and drop it. Excluded same-name entities for this run: HP ProBook / HP Probook laptop and notebook line, Unrelated Probook bookkeeping or accounting products, Other people named Mark Hoffman not employed at Probook.ai, Chrome Web Store listings that are this company's own extension should be attributed to Probook.ai, not treated as a different entity.

EVIDENCE LAW
  * Every factual assertion carries a VERBATIM quote and the URL it came from.
  * NOT FOUND is a correct answer. Never estimate, never infer a number, never fill a gap with a
    plausible guess.
  * Distinguish what the company claims about itself from what a third party reports. A LinkedIn,
    Tracxn or CB-Insights auto-estimate is an ESTIMATE and is labelled as one, never as fact.
  * Name every person with the exact title and the URL that names them. Never invent a person.
  * Prefer primary sources: the company's own pages, its job postings, the funding wire release,
    the investors' announcement posts, the founders' own writing.
  * For any acquisition, rumour or contested item, state explicitly whether it is CONFIRMED,
    DENIED or UNRESOLVED, by whom, with the quote.
